transcription_method: Manual transcription from the supplied PDF text layer. Wording is retained as supplied where practicable; obvious spacing/case normalization is limited and no clinical content has been added.
scope_note: This is a granular transcription of the visible knowledge, clinical reasoning, management, clinical-skill, professional-skill, research and field-training outcomes on pages 6-26. It does not turn topic lists into outcomes. Several multi-part source bullets remain grouped where the source presents them as one outcome.
